notes: Clean of all type/marks: watch dial is blank (no numerals, brand or logo), headphone cups and bag are unbranded, no signage or packaging print anywhere. Minor realism issues: the watch face is featureless with no hands or crown detail, which reads slightly fake up close; the globe is cut off at the top-left frame edge and is tethered by a gold ribbon so it reads as a balloon rather than a globe; the gold ribbon changes width/thickness where it passes behind the bag rim (~x 33-45%, y 50-62%) and its continuity is hard to follow; bag's lower-left bottom corner geometry is slightly soft/undefined around x 10-14%, y 90-94%. Right half of the frame (x>75%) is empty white backdrop — ample clear space for Canva type.
